analysis_md: 因为：$\left\{\begin{aligned}z_x&=2x+4y+6\\z_y&=4x-2y-8\end{aligned}\right.$，由驻点定义可得方程组：$\left\{\begin{aligned}2x+4y+6&=0\\4x-2y-8&=0\end{aligned}\right.$，解得：$\left\{\begin{aligned}x&=1\\y&=-2\end{aligned}\right.$，则驻点为：$(1,-2)$。
